claims.assertion: Mari relays Viera’s account that two Alfratean Class L fighters suffered engine incidents; both crews survived, the second with minor injuries.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu, relaying Viera flight-control account
claims.qualifiers: She does not always trust Viera reports.

claims.assertion: Mari says Saska 1 crews replaced Toleka’s four engines and upgraded Vigilant Eagle with human communications equipment.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu

claims.assertion: Alcyone was to join Toleka in Earth orbit for a year, monitor starseeds and deter; its crew answers to Queen Alenym.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu, reporting Alenym’s declassification
claims.qualifiers: Mari says its media role remains experimental under the First Directive.
